not-yet.why: The result is invented; truthful evidence is an essential criterion.

assisted.response: After an assessor points out the invented number, I remove it and describe the missing-supplies checklist.
assisted.why: The factual correction was prompted, so this is assisted.

independent.response: For problem solving: I noticed missing supplies and proposed a checklist to make checking consistent. This shows identifying a problem and proposing an action. Results have not been measured, so I do not claim 40% improvement. I would compare recorded missing supplies before and after, with limitations.
independent.why: Connects the requirement to a truthful specific action and an explicit outcome limitation, without fabricated numbers.

advanced.response: If the role also requires teamwork, I explain which collaboration facts are actually known and identify the missing example rather than inventing participation.
advanced.why: Responds to a changed job requirement with evidence boundaries and an honest limitation.
